title: Parallel delegated agents run the e2e smoke without port collisions
acceptance: Concurrent delegated agents can run pnpm e2e without colliding on port 8798 (documented E2E_PORT use or serialization).
nextAction: Document E2E_PORT per worktree in delegate-task.md, or serialize local e2e runs for parallel subagents.

evidence.summary: Final review #4 of #643 (finding 9): parallel worktree subagents all bind the default e2e port. Logged 2026-10-27.
Round 20261028a, 2026-10-28: two lane worktrees ran pnpm e2e in parallel with E2E_PORT=8798 and E2E_PORT=8799 and per-worktree e2e/.state, with no port or state collision.
